title: Combinatorial Admissibility in Control-Affine Networks
summary: We study synchronization of heterogeneous control-affine nonlinear agents interconnected through diffusive (relative-output) measurements. We separate the design into an edge-space step, specifying a stabilizing model evolution for relative outputs, and a lift step, realizing the prescribed edge motion using the agents' allowable input directions, constrained by the control-affine geometry of the agents.
